articles.title: Huawei steps up Tau chip roll-out, with Mate XT 2 on track for 1 million sales
articles.summary: Huawei's rapid deployment of its innovative Tau chip, designed to enhance performance and efficiency in its Mate 90 smartphone series, signifies a pivotal shift in the company's strategy to counter US export restrictions and solidify its position in the competitive tech landscape. This breakthrough not only showcases Huawei's resilience but also underscores the growing importance of self-sufficiency in technology development.

articles.title: NVIDIA Opens Applications for 2027–2028 Graduate Fellowships With Awards Up to $60,000
articles.summary: NVIDIA's Graduate Fellowship Program is now accepting applications for 2027-2028, offering up to $60,000 in support to doctoral students whose groundbreaking research leverages accelerated computing technology, a move that promises to drive significant advancements in addressing critical global challenges. This initiative not only empowers the next generation of innovators but also strengthens NVIDIA's commitment to fostering transformative research in the tech landscape.

articles.title: From Training to Production, NVIDIA and CoreWeave Close the Loop on Agentic AI
articles.summary: NVIDIA and CoreWeave have achieved a significant breakthrough by integrating advanced NVIDIA infrastructure into a dedicated AI cloud platform, enhancing efficiency and ROI across multiple deployment generations. This collaboration marks a pivotal step in streamlining the transition from AI training to production, setting a new standard for the industry.

articles.title: Anthropic raises alarm over elite hacking ability of Chinese firm Z.ai’s GLM-5.3
articles.summary: Anthropic has raised significant concerns about the hacking prowess of Z.ai's GLM-5.3, which rivals Anthropic's own advanced models but lacks crucial safety measures, highlighting a dangerous potential for misuse by malicious entities. This alarming development underscores the urgent need for stronger safeguards in AI technologies to prevent exploitation.

articles.title: Disrupting a coordinated model-distillation campaign
articles.summary: OpenAI has successfully thwarted a coordinated effort to extract proprietary model reasoning through advanced defenses against adversarial distillation, marking a significant breakthrough in safeguarding AI intellectual property and enhancing the security of machine learning systems. This development underscores the critical importance of protecting AI models from exploitation in an increasingly competitive landscape.

articles.title: Passportless mess
articles.summary:
• The essay explores the enigmatic persona of Zoran, a figure emblematic of Belgrade's complex identity.  
• It raises questions about the nature of genius and folly, blurring the lines between creation and destruction.  
• Zoran's story serves as a metaphor for the struggles of belonging and the search for meaning in a fragmented world.  
• The narrative invites reflection on how myth and reality intertwine, shaping our understanding of cultural heritage.  
• Ultimately, it challenges readers to consider the value of those who defy convention and provoke thought in society.

articles.title: Helping small businesses put AI to work
articles.summary: OpenAI's collaboration with America’s SBDC aims to empower small businesses by providing practical AI training and localized support, highlighting a transformative shift in how small teams can leverage artificial intelligence to enhance their operations and competitiveness. This initiative not only democratizes access to advanced technology but also underscores the pivotal role of AI in driving innovation and growth in the small business sector.

articles.title: China’s DeepSeek open-sources tools to help Huawei chips supplant Nvidia in AI
articles.summary: Chinese AI start-up DeepSeek has open-sourced a suite of tools designed for Huawei's Ascend AI chips, a significant move aimed at reducing reliance on Nvidia amidst US export restrictions, and potentially reshaping the global AI hardware landscape. This initiative not only enhances Huawei's competitiveness in the AI sector but also signals a broader shift towards self-sufficiency in technology for China.
